label: Root links from Graham Oppy, The Universe Does Not Have a Cause
summary: §§I–II, pp.13–15: Oppy's natural-only causal reality supplies a position in which every participant in an actual causal relation is natural, compatible in his account with either a natural initial cause or regress. The case uses possession of causal power, so applying it requires the account to cover unexercised power and to match Oppy's natural and the selected-world predicates.
